question: To which south-facing, staff-holding deity is obeisance repeatedly offered?
premises: Obeisance is addressed to a deity called south-faced.
The same deity is called staff-holder.
The salutation is repeated to that deity.
inference: The mantra repeatedly offers obeisance to the south-facing, staff-holding deity.
plain_english: Obeisance to you, O South-faced One, O Staff-holder; obeisance be to you.
